description: Runs a fixture-backed Web platform semantics probe for Document.adoptNode moving a node's ownerDocument (removing it from the source) vs importNode copying it. The scripted CDP driver observes page output from the self-hosted fixture `/v2/wpt_b/dom_adoptnode`, and the server-side grader compares it with the Chrome-baked expected answer.
title: adoptNode / importNode cross-document ownership
